7.
The  provisions  of  this  Act  shall  have  effect
notwithstanding anything contained in any other written law,
and accordingly in the event of any conflict or inconsistency
between the provisions of this Act and such other law, the
provisions of this Act shall prevail over such other law.

8.
In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala
and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
